verdict.rationale: Headless CLI build and export is a fair question for a game framework, but the evidence pack never documents a Phaser build or export command, or any CI usage. The only CLI mentioned is an interactive template scaffolder where you 'answer some questions', and 'Publish games with one click' is an editor feature. Neither is a headless build step. Installing Phaser via npm makes it a library a user could bundle with external tools, but that is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can build and export the project from the command line, headless, in CI — no human clicking an editor
